items.t: Rent the Runway to Report Third Quarter 2026 Results on December 10, 2026
items.sum: NEW YORK, Nov. 19, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Rent the Runway, Inc. (“Rent the Runway”) (Nasdaq: RENT) announced today that it expects to release its third quarter 2026 financial results for the quarter ended October 31, 2026 on Thursday, December 10, 2026, before market open. Rent the Runway will host a pre-recorded conference call and webcast with the investment community at 8:30 a.m. Eastern Time
